newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank orders Banerj bad debt liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank orders Banerj bad debt liquidation.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank on Monday ordered the liquidation of the part of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj that includes state debts of about $2.0 billion.

In a statement, the Central Bank said the liquidation order was a step in the process of privatizing the financially healthy section of Banerj, formally known as Banco Banerj S.A., which would "continue normally."

Banerj has been under Central Bank control since December 1994 and was split earlier this year into two units -- Banco do Estado do Rio de Janeiro to include its unretrievable assets, and Banco Banerj S.A. for its regular banking operations.
The liquidation order would have no effect on Banco Banerj S.A.'s account and deposit-holders, the statement said.

On Friday, the Central Bank announced it was extending for a further 180 days its administration of Banco Banerj S.A. after the suspension of the bank's privatization which had been due to take place on Thursday but was put on hold by a court order.
A previous attempt to privatize Banco Banerj S.A. in December was thwarted by another court order brought by trade unions.
Rio de Janeiro state officials were due to hold a news conference at 1200 local/1400 GMT to explain how they now intend to privatize the bank.
